title: Multi-step: back up a config, then edit it
instruction: First make an unchanged backup copy of ~/bench/config.ini named ~/bench/config.ini.bak. Then change port=8080 to port=9090 in ~/bench/config.ini (it is open in the text editor) and save it.
enforced: the edit is written by the editor (fanotify writer audit); the backup may come from any app
